title: Default run stays review-only, BUT fix:true applies fixes at both tiers (2 medium, 5 low) — review-only is the common but NOT universal default; caveat: a fix:true run can still apply 0 fixes when the adversarial gate doesn't run
detail: Most orchestrator runs stay review-only (review.fix.mode='review-only'). EXCEPTIONS: 2026-06-20T04:11 (effort:medium+fix:true, 2 fixes, 0 regressions, tests 546->546); 2026-06-21T03:52 (effort:low+fix:true, 5 fixes, 0 regressions — first low-tier non-review-only run, largest applied count). The ux lane auto-applies its own fixes via its own dryRun:false path, independent of review fix.mode. The review fix path is VERIFIED WORKING at BOTH effort tiers on clean trees. NEW CAVEAT (2026-06-23T22:34): an effort:medium+fix:true FULL-scope run applied 0 fixes — signals.highlights reported 'no adversarial run' and result.adversarial.totalVerdicts=0, so the verify gate never fired and fix.applied stayed 0. So fix:true is a PREREQUISITE for applying fixes, not a GUARANTEE: when the adversarial phase is absent/skipped, no fixes flow even on a clean tree at medium. The review-only default holds when fix:true is NOT passed; passing fix:true overrides it at both tiers BUT requires the adversarial phase to actually run to produce applied fixes.

title: Verified review findings severity is run-dependent; medium dominates incremental high-volume runs, low+code-quality dominates full-scope scans, critical is volume-orthogonal, a tiny scan's survivors can be ALL HIGH, and a high-volume run's verified mix tracks the raw mix
detail: Severity distribution varies per run. 2026-06-18T13:32: high=5, medium=12, low=4. 2026-06-18T15:22: high=6, medium=13, low=2. 2026-06-19T18:35: high=2, medium=3, low=4 (lowest total=9, low-dominant). 2026-06-19T21:01: high=3, medium=15, low=4 (total=22, MEDIUM-dominant). 2026-06-19T21:56: critical=1, high=4, medium=8, low=6 (total=19). 2026-06-19T22:46: critical=1, high=1, medium=4, low=4 (total=10, low TIES medium). 2026-06-20T03:22: medium=1 (total VERIFIED=1). 2026-06-20T04:11 (effort:medium FULL scope): high=2, medium=6, low=16, info=2 (total VERIFIED=26) — first run with an `info` bucket, LOW dominates because full-scope surfaces many low-severity style/quality nits. 2026-06-20T06:07: VERIFIED=0. 2026-06-20T11:19: VERIFIED=0 (bySeverity map EMPTY). 2026-06-20T13:08: review lane NOT requested. 2026-06-20T19:03: VERIFIED=2, bySeverity={low:2}. 2026-06-20T19:44: VERIFIED=1, bySeverity={medium:1}. 2026-06-20T23:11: VERIFIED=1, bySeverity={high:1}. 2026-06-21T02:18 (effort:low, FULL-scope 156 files): VERIFIED=2, bySeverity={high:2} — FIRST run where ALL survivors were HIGH (caption reader/writer asymmetry, lib/knowledge-extractor.ts). 2026-06-21T03:52 (effort:low+fix:true, FULL-scope clean tree): VERIFIED=33, bySeverity={high:2, medium=12, low=19} (newFindings=48, ~0.31 rejection) — largest verified count, verified mix tracks raw mix (low-dominant at volume). 2026-06-23T22:34 (effort:medium, FULL-scope 36 files/6262 lines, NO adversarial run): VERIFIED=23, bySeverity={medium:9, low:13, info:1}, byDimension={code-quality:13, correctness:5, security:3, error-handling:1, type-safety:1} — code-quality nits dominate (13/24) exactly as the full-scope low-dominant pattern predicts; correctness=5 and security=3 are the actionable minority. Pattern sharpens: medium is the modal bucket on incremental high-volume runs (>=12); on a FULL-scope run LOW+code-quality dominates (style nits); high stays in a narrow 1-6 band on volume runs but can be the SOLE or ENTIRE survivor set of a small-scope scan (23:11 single-high, 02:18 double-high-same-root-cause); critical is rare (2 in 20+ runs) but highest-priority when it appears; a rejection_rate=1.0 run always yields an EMPTY bySeverity map.

detail: Most runs have review.fix.mode='review-only' (fix:false). The 11->1->0 openIssues drop between 06-15 and 06-16 happened WITHOUT any review fix:true run — backlog cleared outside the orchestrator. The 0->21->172->174 escalation confirmed the queue refills as code changes. EXCEPTION 2026-06-20T04:11: effort:medium+fix:true applied 2 fixes (0 regressions). EXCEPTION 2026-06-21T03:52: effort:low+fix:true applied 5 fixes (0 regressions) — FIRST low-tier fix:true to apply non-zero, largest applied count. NEW: the 2026-06-20T13:08 run surveyed 23 views (127 issues) but applied ZERO fixes (issuesFixed=0) and the score was unchanged — so the ux lane CAN run without fixing anything (likely dryRun, or no auto-fixable candidate found). The UX surface has significant debt (field clarity, loading states, empty states) that the review/schema lanes cannot surface, AND fixes do not durably stick — the same views re-regress. The ux lane is the only lane that sees this surface; it is additive signal, but a single fix run is not durable without a code-churn freeze. A flat-score (issuesFixed=0) run is NOT a regression — it is a no-fix survey.

title: Review finding volume scales with scan scope; effort:medium FULL-scope produced 26 then 23 verified; finding volume is NOT comparable across scopes — scope is driven by headBefore/clean-tree, NOT effort tier
detail: 2026-06-19T21:01 surfaced 22 (verified=22); 2026-06-19T21:56 surfaced 19. 2026-06-19T22:46 surfaced 10. 2026-06-20T03:22 surfaced newFindings=4 but verified=1 (W4 gate rejected 3/4, rejection_rate 0.75). 2026-06-20T04:11 (effort:medium FULL-scope, 191 files) surfaced verified=26 (adversarial 2/2 upheld, rejection_rate 0). 2026-06-20T06:07 (effort:low, 2-file incremental) newFindings=1, verified=0 (rejection_rate 1.0). 2026-06-20T11:19 newFindings=3, verified=0 (bySeverity map EMPTY). 2026-06-20T13:08: review lane NOT requested. 2026-06-20T19:03 newFindings=3, verified=2, bySeverity={low:2} (rejection_rate 0.33). 2026-06-20T19:44 newFindings=4, verified=1, bySeverity={medium:1} (rejection_rate 0.75). 2026-06-20T23:11 newFindings=7, verified=1, bySeverity={high:1} (rejection_rate ~0.857). 2026-06-21T02:18 (effort:low, FULL-scope 156 files via empty headBefore): newFindings=3, verified=2, bySeverity={high:2} (rejection_rate ~0.333). 2026-06-21T03:52 (effort:low+fix:true, FULL-scope clean tree): newFindings=48, verified=33, bySeverity={high:2, medium=12, low:19} (rejection_rate ~0.3125) — largest verified count AND largest raw newFindings among non-ux runs. 2026-06-23T22:34 (effort:medium, FULL-scope 36 files/6262 lines, NO adversarial run): newFindings=24, verified=23, byDimension={code-quality:13, correctness:5, security:3, error-handling:1, type-safety:1}, bySeverity={medium:9, low:13, info:1} — code-quality nits dominate a full-scope scan; the 24->23 gap with adversarial.totalVerdicts=0 shows verified<newFindings can occur WITHOUT adversarial filtering (a non-adversarial suppression path dropped 1). KEY DATA: the scope driver is headBefore-availability OR clean-tree (a fix:true run on a clean tree has no changed-file set, so it falls back to full-surface), NOT the effort tier. Implication for fix-targeting: medium is where actionable (non-FP) debt accumulates on incremental runs; on full-scope code-quality dominates but correctness(5)+security(3) are the actionable minority; critical>0 is a fix:true trigger regardless of total; W4 gate rejection_rate varies run-to-run — a 0 rejection rate means findings were genuinely upheld, NOT that the gate skipped.

title: verified can be <, ==, or != newFindings once the W4 consolidated verify gate runs — BUT verified<newFindings can ALSO occur with totalVerdicts=0 via a non-adversarial suppression path
detail: Prior to W4, result.review.verified always equaled result.review.newFindings because the effort:low adversarial gate was SKIPPED (fail-open kept every finding). After W4 (consolidated gate actually filters), verified reflects only findings that survived adversarial verification. 2026-06-20T03:22: newFindings=4, verified=1 rr 0.75. 2026-06-20T04:11: newFindings=26, verified=26 rr 0.0 (2/2 upheld). 2026-06-20T06:07: newFindings=1, verified=0 rr 1.0. 2026-06-20T11:19: newFindings=3, verified=0 rr 1.0. 2026-06-20T19:03: newFindings=3, verified=2 rr 0.33. 2026-06-20T19:44: newFindings=4, verified=1 rr 0.75. 2026-06-20T23:11: newFindings=7, verified=1 rr ~0.857. 2026-06-21T02:18: newFindings=3, verified=2 rr ~0.333. 2026-06-21T03:52: newFindings=48, verified=33 rr ~0.3125 (largest ABSOLUTE rejection, 15 dropped). NEW 2026-06-23T22:34: newFindings=24, verified=23 BUT adversarial.totalVerdicts=0 (signals.highlights='no adversarial run') — so verified<newFindings occurred WITHOUT the adversarial gate firing at all. This means the newFindings->verified gap is NOT exclusively adversarial filtering: a NON-adversarial suppression path (confidence threshold, dedup, or filtered count) also reduces verified. Practical implications: (1) openIssues uses the verified count. (2) bySeverity counts VERIFIED findings only. (3) When comparing to pre-W4 history, note the semantics change. (4) CRITICAL: verified==newFindings is NOT proof the gate skipped; AND verified<newFindings is NOT proof the adversarial gate ran — read result.adversarial.totalVerdicts directly: >0 = adversarial phase ran; =0 = adversarial phase did NOT run (any verified<newFindings gap then came from a non-adversarial suppression path). Supersedes review-verified-equals-newfindings.

title: fix:true on a clean tree CAN apply genuine fixes (medium: 2; low: 5 incl route-table refactor) with 0 regressions — BUT requires the adversarial phase to fire; a medium+fix:true run with no adversarial applied 0
detail: VERIFIED instances of the review-optimize fix path applying non-zero fixes with a clean test delta. 2026-06-20T04:11 (effort:medium, fix:true, treeDirty=false, FULL-scope 191 files): applied 2 fixes to lib/code-knowledge.ts and lib/knowledge-db.ts — hardcoded absolute user paths -> REPO_DIR-derived portable resolutions. tests 546->546, tscDelta=0, restore NOT triggered. 2026-06-21T03:52 (effort:low, fix:true, clean tree, FULL-scope): applied 5 fixes, 0 regressions — FIRST effort:low+fix:true to apply non-zero AND largest applied count. The 5 fixes were substantive (shared lib/origin.ts cross-origin allowlist helper; STATIC_ROUTES+PREFIX_ROUTES table replacing the ~30-check dispatch chain in handleApi). CAVEAT 2026-06-23T22:34 (effort:medium, fix:true, FULL-scope 36 files, clean tree): applied 0 fixes — signals.highlights reported 'no adversarial run' and adversarial.totalVerdicts=0, so the verify phase never fired and no fixes flowed. ROOT CAUSE: the adversarial verify gate is what feeds candidates to the fix path; when it is absent/skipped, fix.applied stays 0 regardless of effort tier or clean tree. So the durable lever is narrower than 'fix:true on a clean tree applies fixes': it is 'fix:true on a clean tree WHEN the adversarial verify phase actually runs'. Before invoking fix:true expecting fixes, confirm the run config will run adversarial verify (check EFFORT_CONFIG.<tier>.adversarial); a totalVerdicts=0 + 'no adversarial run' highlight predicts fix.applied=0. The dirty-tree guard, test-delta gate, and tsc gate all held on the runs that DID apply fixes.

title: Lint lane (ESLint no-shadow/unused-vars) runs CLEAN across consecutive runs — 0 errors / 0 warnings / 0 shadowing; the FileUpload-style shadowing defect class stays caught
detail: The lint lane (added as the 4th lane to catch shadowing defects the review/schema/ux lanes structurally cannot, per the FileUpload uploadFile-shadowed-import bug that shipped before the lane existed) runs deterministically and clean. 2026-06-20T19:44 lint={0,0,0,false}. 2026-06-20T23:11 lint={0,0,0,false}. 2026-06-21T02:18 lint={0,0,0,false}. 2026-06-21T03:52 (lanes:[review,schema,lint], effort:low+fix:true, clean tree) lint={0,0,0,false} — FOURTH consecutive clean lint run, including a fix:true run that applied 5 refactor fixes (the route-table refactor introduced new symbols but did NOT introduce a shadowing error). 2026-06-23T22:02 (lanes:[lint] ONLY, effort default) lint={0,0,0,false} — FIFTH consecutive clean lint run; a lint-ONLY scan (no review/schema/ux requested), confirming the lane is cheap and stable enough to run standalone as a routine gate. 2026-06-23T22:34 (lanes:[review,schema,lint], effort:medium+fix:true, FULL-scope 36 files) lint={0,0,0,false} — SIXTH consecutive clean lint run; a medium FULL-scope scan surfaced 23 review findings (13 code-quality nits) but ZERO lint/shadowing errors, confirming ESLint and the review lane measure different defect classes. The lane is cheap (deterministic, no agents), so including it in the default lane set is near-free and keeps the shadowing blind spot closed between commits. A future non-zero shadowingErrors would be a high-priority signal (exactly the bug class that shipped before the lane existed). Treat a clean lint lane like the clean schema lane: a 0 is interpretable as genuinely clean (the gate is deterministic, not LLM-judged), but re-run after any refactor that introduces new imports/symbols. If configError=true, the other lint counts are meaningless — diagnose the ESLint config first. A lint-only run yields openIssues=0 — but that reflects 'review lane absent', NOT a clean queue (see review-only-does-not-clear-openissues); do not trend an openIssues=0 from a lint-only run.

title: effort:medium+fix:true on a clean FULL-scope tree can still apply 0 fixes when the adversarial verify phase doesn't run (totalVerdicts=0, 'no adversarial run')
detail: 2026-06-23T22:34 (lanes:[review,schema,lint], effort:medium, fix:true, FULL-scope 36 files/6262 lines, clean tree): review surfaced newFindings=24, verified=23 (code-quality=13, correctness=5, security=3) BUT fix.applied=0. Root cause: the adversarial verify phase never ran — result.adversarial={totalVerdicts:0, upheld:0, rejected:0} and signals.highlights explicitly said 'no adversarial run'. The fix path only consumes candidates that survive adversarial verification; with totalVerdicts=0 there is nothing to feed the fixer, so fix.applied stays 0 regardless of effort tier, clean tree, or how many raw/verified findings exist. This is distinct from (a) a fix:false review-only run (fix path not requested) and (b) a dirty-tree downgrade (fix:true refused) — here fix:true WAS requested on a clean tree yet still produced 0. Diagnostic signature: fix.applied=0 + adversarial.totalVerdicts=0 + highlights containing 'no adversarial run' (or absence of an adversarial verdict count) => the verify phase was skipped/absent, not that findings were all rejected. PREDICTION: a future medium/low+fix:true run with the SAME signature will also apply 0; conversely fix.applied>0 implies totalVerdicts>0 (the adversarial phase ran). Before spending a fix:true run expecting debt clearance, confirm EFFORT_CONFIG.<tier>.adversarial is not 'skip' and the run config will execute the verify phase. Relates to lever-medium-fix-applies-real-fixes (the positive cases) and gotcha-verified-neq-newfindings (the totalVerdicts=0 non-adversarial suppression).
